detail.command: git log --oneline -1; for f in src/courses/data/ancient-temple.ts src/courses/data/arctic-base.ts src/courses/data/volcano.ts; do echo "=== $f ==="; for s in 1 2 3; do L=$(git show :$s:$f | wc -l); M=$(git show :$s:$f | awk '{ if (length($0)>m) m=length($0) } END { print m }'); echo "  stage$s: lines=$L maxlinelen=$M"; done; echo '  --- ours(office) head ---'; git show :2:$f | head -10; done; echo '=== long lines in src ==='; git grep -n '.\{400,\}' -- src | cut -c1-100
